# Load everything

#Sample prep
```{r}
ps <- subset_samples(ps_consensus, !sample %in% c("blanc.1", "blanc.2", "blanc.3", "blanc.4"))

ps_ori <- subset_samples(ps_consensus, sampling_time == "ori")
sample_names(ps_ori)[sample_names(ps_ori) == "ori21f2"] <- "orib2f2"
sample_names(ps_ori)[sample_names(ps_ori) == "oribi31"] <- "orib3f1"
ps_agri <- subset_samples(ps_ori, soil == "a")
ps_fo <- subset_samples(ps_ori, soil == "f")

nbragri <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_agri) > 0, ps_agri)
ntaxa(nbragri) #262
nsamples(ps_agri) #28

nbrforest <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_fo) > 0, ps_fo)
ntaxa(nbrforest) #278
nsamples(ps_fo) #29

#Remove sample without reads
ps_agri <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps_agri) > 0, ps_agri)
ps_fo <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps_fo) > 0, ps_fo)
```

# Crop soil
## Alpha diversity
```{r}
# Alpha diversity
alpha_divagri <- estimate_richness(ps_agri, measures = c("Shannon", "Simpson", "Observed", "Chao1"))

# Adding metadata
metadataagri <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps_agri))

# Merge
alpha_divagri<- cbind(metadataagri, alpha_divagri)

alpha_divagri %>%
filter(treatment == "ctl") %>%
summarise(CV = (sd(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100) #99.2887

```


```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(FSA)

indices <- c("Shannon", "Simpson", "Observed", "Chao1")
variables <- c("block", "treatment")

resultats_kw_agri <- expand_grid(indice = indices, variable = variables) %>%
rowwise() %>%
mutate(p_value = kruskal.test(as.formula(paste(indice, "~", variable)), data = alpha_divagri)$p.value) %>%
ungroup() %>%
group_by(variable) %>%
mutate(p_corrigee = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
ungroup()

resultats_kw_agri

# Posthoc
dunnshannon<-dunnTest(Shannon ~ treatment, data = alpha_divagri, method = "bh")%>%
add_significance()

dunnsimpson<-dunnTest(Simpson ~ treatment, data = alpha_divagri, method = "bh")%>%
add_significance()

dunnobs<-dunnTest(Observed ~ treatment, data = alpha_divagri, method = "bh")%>%
add_significance()

dunnchao<-dunnTest(Chao1 ~ treatment, data = alpha_divagri, method = "bh")%>%
add_significance()

# crop color
colors_treatment <- c(
"ctl"    = "grey70", 
"10^-08" = "#FEE6CE",  
"10^-06" = "#FDAE6B",  
"10^-04" = "#FD8D3C",  
"10^-02" = "#E6550D",  
"10^-0"  = "#A63603")

treatment_names <- c(
"ctl"    = "CTL", 
"10^-08" = "D8",  
"10^-06" = "D6",  
"10^-04" = "D4",  
"10^-02" = "D2",  
"10^-0"  = "D0")

shannonagri <- ggplot(alpha_divagri, aes(x=treatment, y=Shannon, fill=treatment, color=treatment)) +  
geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) + 
geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.2)+
scale_fill_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_color_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_x_discrete(labels=treatment_names) +
theme_minimal() +
labs(x="", y="Shannon diversity index") +
theme( legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
panel.background = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray95", size=0))

simpsonagri <- ggplot(alpha_divagri, aes(x=treatment, y=Simpson, fill=treatment, color=treatment)) +  
geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) + 
geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.2)+
scale_fill_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_color_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_x_discrete(labels=treatment_names) +
theme_minimal() +
labs(x="", y="Simpson diversity index") +
theme( legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
panel.background = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray95", size=0)) 

chaoagri <- ggplot(alpha_divagri, aes(x=treatment, y=Chao1, fill=treatment, color=treatment)) +  
geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) + 
geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.2)+
scale_fill_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_color_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_x_discrete(labels=treatment_names) +
theme_minimal() +
labs(x="", y="Chao1 index") +
theme( legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
panel.background = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray95", size=0)) 

obsagri <- ggplot(alpha_divagri, aes(x=treatment, y=Observed, fill=treatment, color=treatment)) +  
geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) + 
geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.2)+

scale_color_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +

theme_minimal() +
```

## Correlation alpha diversity & enzymes
```{r}
enzyme <- enzyme %>% mutate(sample = paste0("ori", sample))

enzymeagri <- enzyme %>% filter(soil == "agricole")

#Remove CTL because it doesnt make sens to keep it.
enzyme_agri <- enzymeagri %>% filter(treatment != 0)

alpha_divagri <- alpha_divagri %>% filter (treatment!= "ctl")

div_enzyme <- alpha_divagri %>%
left_join(enzyme_agri,by = "sample")

div_indices <- c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson")
enzymes <- c("Protease", "Desaminase", "Bglucosidase")

cor_results <- div_enzyme %>%
pivot_longer(cols = all_of(div_indices), names_to = "Diversity_index", values_to = "Diversity_value") %>%
pivot_longer(cols = all_of(enzymes), names_to = "Enzyme", values_to = "Enzyme_activity") %>%
group_by(Diversity_index, Enzyme) %>%
cor_test(Diversity_value,Enzyme_activity, method = "spearman") %>%
ungroup() %>%
adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
add_significance("p.adj")

```

## Beta diversity 
```{r}
ps_agri <- subset_samples(ps_agri, treatment != "ctl")

# Abundance table
otu_agri <- as(otu_table(ps_agri), "matrix")

# Sample in line
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_agri)) {
otu_agri <- t(otu_agri)}

# Hellinger
ps_hellingeragri <- decostand(otu_agri, method = "hellinger")

# Euclidienne distance 
dist_hellingeragri <- vegdist(ps_hellingeragri, diag=TRUE, upper=FALSE, method = "euclidean")

# Extract metadata
metadataagri <- sample_data(ps_agri)
metadata_dfagri <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_agri))
metadata_dfagri$block <-as.factor(metadata_dfagri$block)
metadata_dfagri$treatment <-as.factor(metadata_dfagri$treatment)

betadisper_resultagri <- betadisper(dist_hellingeragri, group = metadata_dfagri$treatment)

plot(betadisper_resultagri)
anova_res<-anova(betadisper_resultagri)  # p-value 0.07931

# Extract values
F_value <- anova_res$`F value`[1]
p_anova <- anova_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]

# Dispersion table
df_disp <- data.frame(sample = names(betadisper_resultagri$distances), distance = betadisper_resultagri$distances, group = metadata_dfagri$treatment)

table_disp <- df_disp %>%
group_by(group) %>%
summarise(n = n(), mean_dispersion = mean(distance), sd = sd(distance), se = sd / sqrt(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
mutate(F_value = F_value, p_anova = p_anova)

# Tukey post-hoc
tukey_res <- TukeyHSD(betadisper_resultagri)
tukey_table <- as.data.frame(tukey_res$group)
tukey_table$comparison <- rownames(tukey_table)
rownames(tukey_table) <- NULL

tukey_table <- tukey_table %>%
rename(diff = diff, lower = lwr, upper = upr, 'p_adj' = `p adj`)

# Graph beta-dispersion
kruskal.test(df_disp$distance ~ df_disp$group)
#p-value = 0.1105

beta_dispagri <- ggplot(df_disp, aes(x = group, y = distance, fill = group, color=group)) +
geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) +
geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.2)+
scale_fill_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_color_manual(name="Dilution", values=colors_treatment, labels=treatment_names) +
scale_x_discrete(labels=treatment_names)+ 
labs(x = "", y = "Distance to centroid") + theme_minimal() + 
theme( legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray95", size=0))   
  

set.seed(18575748)  
permanova_agri <-adonis2(dist_hellingeragri ~ treatment, data = metadata_dfagri, permutations = 999, by="terms", strata = metadata_dfagri$block)

print(permanova_agri)
#             Df SumOfSqs      R2      F Pr(>F)    
#treatment  4   5.7919 0.34264 2.3455  0.001 ***
#Residual  18  11.1121 0.65736                  
#Total     22  16.9040 1.00000    

permanovaagri_out <- permanova_agri %>%
tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Variable")
write_xlsx(permanovaagri_out, path = "native_soil/Results/permanova_crop_native_its.xlsx")

```

### PCOA
```{r}
# PCoA
pcoa_res <- cmdscale(dist_hellingeragri, k = 2, eig = TRUE)

# Data frame for ggplot2
pcoa_df <- data.frame(
SampleID = metadata_dfagri$sample,
PCoA1 = pcoa_res$points[, 1],
PCoA2 = pcoa_res$points[, 2],
treatment = metadata_dfagri$treatment)

# Rermanova results
permanova_results <- permanova_agri 
r2_treatment <- round(permanova_results$R2[1], 3)
pval_treatment <- signif(permanova_results$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3)

annotation_text <- paste("PERMANOVA results:", paste("Dilution: R² =", r2_treatment, ", p =", pval_treatment), sep = "\n")

colors_treatment <- c(
  "ctl"    = "grey70", 
  "10^-08" = "#FEE6CE",  
  "10^-06" = "#FDAE6B",  
  "10^-04" = "#FD8D3C",  
  "10^-02" = "#E6550D",  
  "10^-0"  = "#A63603" )

agripcoa <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = treatment)) +
geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) + 
stat_ellipse(aes(group = treatment, color = treatment), linetype = 1, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) + 
labs(title = "", x = paste0("PCoA1 (", round(pcoa_res$eig[1] / sum(pcoa_res$eig) * 100, 2), "%)"), y = paste0("PCoA2 (", round(pcoa_res$eig[2] / sum(pcoa_res$eig) * 100, 2), "%)")) +
scale_color_manual(name = "Dilution", values = colors_treatment, labels = treatment_names)+ 
theme_classic() +
theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 11), axis.line = element_line(colour = "white"), panel.border = element_rect(colour = "white", fill = NA, size = 0.5), axis.title = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"), legend.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 11), legend.text = element_text(color = "black")) +
annotate("text", x = -2, y = -1, label = annotation_text, hjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black")

```

## Correlation alpha diversity & enzymes IIIII
```{r}
enzymefo <- enzyme %>% filter(soil == "forestier")

#Remove CTL because it doesnt make sens to keep it.
enzymefo <- enzymefo %>% filter(treatment != 0)

alpha_divfo <- alpha_divfo %>% filter(treatment != "ctl")

div_enzymefo <- alpha_divfo %>%inner_join(enzymefo, by = "sample")

div_indices <- c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson")
enzymes <- c("Protease", "Desaminase", "Bglucosidase")

cor_resultsfo <- div_enzymefo %>%
pivot_longer(cols = all_of(div_indices), names_to = "Diversity_index", values_to = "Diversity_value") %>%
pivot_longer(cols = all_of(enzymes), names_to = "Enzyme", values_to = "Enzyme_activity") %>%
group_by(Diversity_index, Enzyme) %>%
cor_test(Diversity_value,Enzyme_activity, method = "spearman") %>%
ungroup() %>%
adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
add_significance("p.adj")

```

### PCOA
```{r}
pcoa_res <- cmdscale(dist_hellingerfo, k = 2, eig = TRUE)

pcoa_df <- data.frame(
SampleID = metadata_dffo$sample,
PCoA1 = pcoa_res$points[, 1],
PCoA2 = pcoa_res$points[, 2],
treatment = metadata_dffo$treatment)

# Permanova results
permanova_results <- permanova_fo  
r2_treatment <- round(permanova_results$R2[1], 3)
pval_treatment <- signif(permanova_results$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3)

annotation_text <- paste("PERMANOVA results:", paste("Dilution: R² =", r2_treatment, ", p =", pval_treatment), sep = "\n")

fopcoa <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = treatment)) +
geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) + 
stat_ellipse(aes(group = treatment, color = treatment), linetype = 1, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
labs(title = "", x = paste0("PCoA1 (", round(pcoa_res$eig[1] / sum(pcoa_res$eig) * 100, 2), "%)"), y = paste0("PCoA2 (", round(pcoa_res$eig[2] / sum(pcoa_res$eig) * 100, 2), "%)")) +
scale_color_manual(name = "Dilution", values = colors_treatmentfo, labels = treatment_names )+ theme_classic() +
theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 14), axis.line = element_line(colour = "white"), axis.title = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"), legend.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 11), legend.text = element_text(color = "black")) + annotate("text", x = -0.75, y = -1, label = annotation_text, hjust = 0, size = 4, color = "black")

```
